whatsNew: 1.1 brings Mintmark to iPad. The app now installs on iPad as well as iPhone, and the wider screen is used properly: capture, the collection and an appraisal each fill the room instead of stretching a phone layout. Everything else is the app you already had — one photograph in, the identification, a Sheldon grade and a collector-market range out, with the reasoning and the checks that would confirm it. Free, no account, no in-app purchases.
notes: 1.1 replaced 1.0 (build 8) on 22 November 2026. The next release needs a new version record, so version, versionId and build change together here first.
